notice: All scores are editorial seed examples, not objective rankings or scientific measures. No audio/video is included.

mechanisms.name: Timing & Silence
mechanisms.description: Pacing, pauses, and delayed release: the spaces that make an audience anticipate what comes next.
mechanisms.cues: Unexpected pauses, elongated setups, anti-punchlines, withheld response.
mechanisms.music: Rest notes, negative space, pickup beats, and the drop after a long break.

mechanisms.name: Escalation
mechanisms.description: A small problem compounds until the original situation becomes gloriously unmanageable.
mechanisms.cues: Rising stakes, repeated doubling down, increasingly disproportionate reactions.
mechanisms.music: Builds, risers, intensifying patterns, and dynamic ramps.

mechanisms.name: Absurdity
mechanisms.description: The logic of a scene departs from ordinary reality but stays consistent enough to follow.
mechanisms.cues: Surreal premises, non sequiturs, alternate rules, impossible events.
mechanisms.music: Unexpected key changes, odd textures, and hard rhythmic left turns.

mechanisms.name: Character
mechanisms.description: Voice, posture, worldview, and persona make a line funny before the punchline lands.
mechanisms.cues: Distinct diction, physical mannerisms, recurring personality traits.
mechanisms.music: Timbre, vocal identity, recurring motifs, and character-led hooks.

mechanisms.name: Social Friction
mechanisms.description: Awkwardness and clashing expectations produce tension between people.
mechanisms.cues: Social misreads, embarrassment, stubborn denial, public discomfort.
mechanisms.music: Off-beat accents, interrupted phrases, and tension against the groove.

mechanisms.name: Deadpan Conviction
mechanisms.description: An impossible or foolish premise is delivered with absolute sincerity or institutional confidence.
mechanisms.cues: Serious framing, fake authority, minimal reaction, formal delivery.
mechanisms.music: Steady pulse beneath increasingly improbable material.

mechanisms.name: Repetition & Callback
mechanisms.description: A phrase or idea returns, gains context, and changes what the listener expects.
mechanisms.cues: Repeated refrains, familiar reversals, callbacks, pattern interruption.
mechanisms.music: Loops, sampled hooks, variations, and the payoff of recurring themes.

mechanisms.name: Taboo & Shock
mechanisms.description: A norm is abruptly challenged, with comic distance or reframing shaping the response.
mechanisms.cues: Boundary-pushing premises, sudden contrast, dark exaggeration.
mechanisms.music: Abrupt cuts and dissonant accents; context and audience comfort matter.

mechanisms.name: Rhythm & Musicality
mechanisms.description: Speech and laughter already contain cadence, breath, pitch, syncopation, and groove.
mechanisms.cues: Distinctive vocal rhythm, repeatable syllables, phrasing, sonic texture.
mechanisms.music: Chop dialogue as a rhythmic instrument; treat silence as part of the composition.

profiles.name: Norm Macdonald
profiles.context: Stand-up, talk shows, long-form joke telling
profiles.note: Illustrative signature emphasizing extended setup, deadpan framing, and anti-payoff.

profiles.name: Tim Robinson
profiles.note: Illustrative signature emphasizing escalating arguments, social friction, and stubborn repetition.

profiles.name: Trevor Moore
profiles.context: The Whitest Kids U' Know; musical comedy
profiles.note: Illustrative signature combining outrageous premises with straight-faced presentation and songwriting.

profiles.name: William Montgomery
profiles.note: Illustrative signature highlighting abrupt energy shifts, recurring phrases, and forceful vocal cadence.

profiles.name: Dave Foley
profiles.note: Illustrative signature emphasizing sustained character portrayal and increasingly absurd situations.

profiles.name: Harland Williams
profiles.note: Illustrative signature for conversational detours, strange images, and playful deadpan.

profiles.name: Miss Swan
profiles.note: A character-level rather than performer-level illustration of vocal identity and repeated misunderstandings.

moments.title: The long-form anti-joke
moments.description: The setup grows long enough that waiting becomes part of the laugh.

moments.title: Coffin Flop
moments.description: A wildly implausible pitch defended with escalating seriousness.

moments.title: About That
moments.description: A techno reinterpretation of an emphatic comic question; a case study in cadence and repetition.

moments.title: Turbo Tyme
moments.description: Sample-based synthwave that turns the surreal urgency of a sketch into rhythmic energy.

moments.title: Auto Erotic
moments.description: An example of dark absurdism and unsettling premise inversion; listed without distributing footage.

moments.title: Never Gonna Stop
moments.description: An energetic phrase transforms into a soulful recurring musical motif.

moments.title: Girl Drink Drunk
moments.description: A character premise grows through repetition, commitment, and escalating consequences.

moments.title: Look Alikes
moments.description: A lo-fi hip-hop treatment of a MADtv character's memorable speaking patterns.

moments.title: Get Yoked
moments.description: A dance-oriented example of transforming an expressive sitcom voice into a hook.

moments.title: Conversational detour
moments.description: A normal observation heads into bizarre specificity while keeping a straight face.
